items.title: It's Tim Cook's final day as Apple CEO. Here's what investors need from John Ternus.
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) CEO Tim Cook is officially passing the reins to incoming CEO John Ternus on Tuesday, Sept. 1. Morning Brief host Julie Hyman, Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley, and Barron's associate editor Al Root discuss Cook's future involvement with the company, Ternus's big jobs ahead, and more.

items.title: KKR's 'Berkshire Hathaway' strategy bears first fruit with $17B USI sale
items.summary: Dmitry Vinogradov/Getty Images KKR has made its first major exit from its Strategic Holdings portfolio, representing a significant step towards the firm’s ambition of creating a “mini Berkshire Hathaway.” The New York alternatives manager has agreed to sell USI Insurance Services, one of the largest insurance brokerage and consulting firms in the US, to Aon for around $17 billion, the firm announced on Monday.
